summary: Frontend-only testing of the weekly questionnaire + 3-month bilan features for Médical o2 Provence Expo app. All critical flows pass: Suivi 'Mon ressenti' card shows 'Questionnaire de la semaine à remplir' and start button opens /questionnaire; Home shows home-survey-card when due and hides it after completion; intro -> 14 questions one-per-screen with auto-advance (~200ms) and 'Question X sur 14' progress; option-0-everywhere yields wellbeing 100 % and Epworth 0/24 (gene opt 0 'Aucune gêne' excludes issue, no problems button); option-3-everywhere yields wellbeing 7 % and Epworth 24/24 'Somnolence importante' (ronflement 'Je dors seul(e)' correctly excluded) and 'Voir les solutions' opens /guide/problemes; after completion Suivi card updates to 'Prochain questionnaire dans 7 jours' and persists after reload (localStorage); /bilan screen shows bilan-nights, bilan-avg, bilan-ok, bilan-wellbeing, bilan-epworth, bilan-chart, bilan-next-date, bilan-share-button; empty bilan state shows bilan-start-survey-button; regression Home, Guides, Entretien (reminder-card present with web info), Chat all load fine. Only non-blocking console warnings: expo-notifications web warning and 'shadow*' style props deprecation warning. No deprecated expo-av/barcode-scanner packages detected.

issues: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Likely in Card component (ui.tsx) with shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset — update to boxShadow for RN Web compatibility.

action_items: (Optional) Migrate shadow* style props in Card (src/ui.tsx) to boxShadow to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: src/questionnaire.ts computeScores correctly handles null score (ronflement 'Je dors seul(e)') — verified by option-3 run (ronflement not contributing to max).
store.tsx surveyDueIn uses days since last survey; initial state (no surveys) returns 0 so due=true as expected.
survey-card.tsx start button is only rendered when due — correct hide after completion.
bilan.tsx Share.share is used; on web it may be unavailable — error swallowed via .catch, acceptable per request.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed; tests cleared localStorage before each run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Header back button in /questionnaire has testID='header-back-button' (BackHeader component in src/ui.tsx). Auto-advance delay is ~200ms, use wait_for_timeout(350-400ms). Direct navigation to /questionnaire works via EXPO_BACKEND_URL. For bilan empty state: visit /bilan without surveys/logs. Localstorage keys: mo2_surveys, mo2_logs, mo2_task_done, mo2_notif_enabled.
